start.title: At the Gate of Sodom
start.text:
It is evening. You are sitting in the gateway of the city of Sodom.
Two angels arrive at Sodom. What do you do?

choices.text: Get up to meet them and bow down with your face to the ground
Turn away and ignore the strangers
Chase them out of the city with a staff

wickedness.title: Come to My House
wickedness.text:
You speak to the two strangers.
What do you say?

choices.text: 'My lords, please turn aside to your servant's house; you can wash your feet and spend the night'
'Leave Sodom at once â it is not safe here'
'Sleep here in the square as you planned'

strangers.title: A Meal in Your House
strangers.text:
The angels come home with you.
What do you prepare for them?

choices.text: Prepare a meal for them, baking bread without yeast
Offer them only water and send them to bed
Offer them a lamb roasted with fire

welcome.title: The Men of the City
welcome.text:
Before you go to bed, all the men of Sodom â young and old â surround the house.
What do they demand?

choices.text: 'Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us'
'Give us food and gold from your house'
'Welcome us to eat with the strangers'

mob.title: At the Door
mob.text:
You go outside to speak to the crowd.
What do you do with the door?

choices.text: Go out to them and shut the door behind you
Leave the door wide open so the guests can flee
Hand the guests over to the crowd yourself

angels_warn.title: Pulled Inside
angels_warn.text:
The crowd surges to break down the door.
What do the angels do?

choices.text: The angels reach out, pull you back into the house, and strike the men with blindness
The angels open the door and let the crowd inside
The angels vanish silently and abandon you

sons_in_law.title: Warn Your Family
sons_in_law.text:
The angels tell you to warn your relatives about the coming destruction.
How do your sons-in-law respond?

choices.text: Your sons-in-law think you are joking
Your sons-in-law believe you and follow at once
Your sons-in-law kill you for the warning

urge.title: Dawn â Flee for Your Lives
urge.text:
As dawn breaks, the angels urge you to hurry.
What do they say?

choices.text: 'Flee for your lives! Don't look back, and don't stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains'
'Take your gold and hide inside the city'
'Wait a few more days before leaving'

flee.title: Fire from Heaven
flee.text:
You reach the town of Zoar as the sun rises.
What does the Lord do to Sodom and Gomorrah?

choices.text: The Lord rains down burning sulfur out of the heavens on Sodom and Gomorrah
The Lord sends a great flood over the cities
The Lord spares the cities and lets them stand

wife_looks.title: She Looked Back
wife_looks.text:
Your wife is behind you.
What happens to her?

choices.text: She looks back and becomes a pillar of salt
She runs safely into Zoar with you
She turns into a bird and flies away

aftermath.title: The Smoke of the Plain
aftermath.text:
Early in the morning, Abraham gets up and looks down toward Sodom.
He sees dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.
God remembered Abraham, and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe.
